note: Decisions deferred on purpose. Each item has a review date: on that date, run the check and decide go, drop or extend. Decided items stay listed with their outcome.

items.title: Do tokens need a verified email before they are issued?
items.context: Phase 1 returns the token straight from POST /api/keys without checking the email, because sending mail needs a domain (#request-email-notifications). A leaked or fake-email token only exposes request statuses, so the risk is spam requests, which per-token and per-IP limits should contain.
items.check: Count keys issued, requests per key, and requests declined as spam or nonsense since release.
items.decide_if: Go (verify by email link before the token works) if more than 10% of requests are spam or one IP created more than 20 keys; otherwise drop and keep direct tokens.
items.outcome: 2026-10-28: decided go early by the owner (no data needed): tokens only after confirming the email, see #request-email-confirm.

items.title: Should the docs and links use www.vectilume.dev, with vectilume.vercel.app redirecting to it?
items.context: vectilume.dev is live on Vercel with www as primary (the apex redirects to www). /request-icons, public/icon-requests.md, README and the npm READMEs still use https://vectilume.vercel.app; confirmation links already use the host the visitor came from. Owner has not chosen www vs apex yet.
items.check: Ask the owner: www.vectilume.dev or vectilume.dev as primary, and whether vectilume.vercel.app should redirect.
items.decide_if: Go: replace the base URL everywhere (BASE in request-icons/page.tsx, icon-requests.md, README, package READMEs with the next npm publish) and add the redirect in Vercel Domains. Drop: keep vercel.app as the documented address.
